title: Overdraft race in withdrawals
root_cause: TOCTOU race in withdraw(): SELECT balance then (if sufficient) UPDATE balance in separate statements with no row lock. Two concurrent withdraws interleave as read-read-debit-debit: both see the same pre-debit balance, both pass the Python check, both debit, leaving the account negative despite the check.
fix: Atomic conditional debit: single UPDATE ... WHERE balance >= amount, success iff rowcount==1, else re-check existence to raise ValueError vs InsufficientFunds. No SELECT FOR UPDATE needed; row-level lock only on contended account preserves throughput.

repro_report.example_violation: overdraft violation: account 1 balance -16000 < 0 after 32 concurrent withdraws of 1000 from 1000 (round 1)
